plugins.name: @dsh-web/files
plugins.description: A file browser, uploader and downloader for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin

manifests.description: A file browser, uploader and downloader for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin
The Network settings page: the CORS proxy this page falls back to, as an ordinary dsh plugin
Installing plugins from the browser, as an ordinary dsh plugin
Choose the machine this session runs on: the Node container, or an emulated PC running DOS, Windows or Linux
A link to this project's repository at the sidebar foot, as an ordinary dsh plugin
A terminal for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin
dsh-market.com/tryon: deep-link skin application plus the try-on toolbar, running inside the browser dsh shell

DSH web GUI right-panel system: a pixel-faithful re-implementation of AionUi's Explorer + Preview columns (file tree, filename search, git changes, multi-tab preview of 10+ formats) driven by real host-side fs/git services, hot-pluggable via a profile bundle without any dsh source changes
Chat recovery for the dsh web GUI: fork-based editing and explicit retry of the last failed turn while preserving the original session
Community plugin index data source for the dsh web ecosystem: community.json is the single source of the Workshop store plugin list and the dsh-market.com plugin manifest.

Desktop launcher + one-click shutdown for dsh: create a double-click desktop icon that starts dsh web and opens the Web GUI, plus a floating power button that exits the host process gracefully. Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Transactional rescue mode for DSH profiles with a supervised launcher, isolated recovery capsule, deterministic repairs, health monitoring, and a local Web recovery console
External dsh web GUI plugin: a blank-session git branch selector + Git graph, with real host-side git operations and guards, as a dsh profile bundle

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset — the first model request exposes only the builtin Minimal exact two-tool surface (persistent bash plus str_replace_editor) with no runtime contexts or injected instructions (Minimal-aligned trajectory anchor), promotion is gated on the first minimal-like reasoning block with a fallback, and the wire then switches to PTC Mode (a single run_code tool over the full registry) with the ordinary injections returning afterwards. The preset files are synced into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets on host startup. Hot-pluggable — mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Workshop browser card: browse skins, pets and community plugins from dsh-market.com and install them in the GUI (assets into the DSH home directories, plugins through the optional plugin manager).
Multi-pet companion plugin for the dsh web GUI: a registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity, with per-pet naming, petting/feeding interactions and an affinity score

Plugin manager tab for the dsh web GUI Plugins settings section: installs plugins from npm or git through the official host channels, lists installed plugins with next-start enablement switches, surfaces install-time conflict actions with undo, and hands failures off to repair conversations.

Scan-to-pair mobile and PC remote control for the dsh web GUI: QR entry beside the settings button, one-time pairing tokens, a gated /remote/api desktop channel, live device status, and revocable sessions
DSH web GUI plugin: sidebar-foot Session ID panel listing every session with its full id and one-click copy (browser-only; no source changes).
DSH skill center: browse loaded skills by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), enable or disable, create and delete, in a web GUI panel.

Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store (~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json, import from ~/.ssh/config), a persistent ssh2 connection pool with jump-host support, exec / PTY web terminal / SFTP transfer / local port-forward tunnels / cluster execution, plus agent tools (ssh_list, ssh_exec, ssh_upload, ssh_download, ssh_tunnel, ssh_cluster). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Host-authoritative task board for the DSH Web GUI with real session execution, Host cron scheduling, and optional cross-platform idle-sleep protection; mounted without DSH source changes.

Model-facing describe_image tool for the dsh web GUI: gives a text-only model image understanding by asking a vision-language model at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to describe one image (local path, http(s) URL, or attachment reference). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
DSH Web UI 全家桶聚合插件：一键安装全部功能插件（task-board / git-graph / pet / remote-web-ui / web-ui-settings / skin-center / community-plugins / compat shim）。compat 桥接层已并入本包（src/client），无需独立 compat npm 包。
Web UI plugin group for the dsh settings page: one first-level settings section that hosts the dsh-web family plugins' enable switches and configuration forms.

In-GUI skin center for the dsh web GUI — the single skin package: skins are pure asset directories (built-in plus $DSH_HOME/skins) loaded and rendered only by the skin center; live try-on and one-click apply switch atomically in the page (no reload, no cordis.patch.yml rewrite, no restart)

manifests.description: DSH web GUI right-panel system: a pixel-faithful re-implementation of AionUi's Explorer + Preview columns (file tree, filename search, git changes, multi-tab preview of 10+ formats) driven by real host-side fs/git services, hot-pluggable via a profile bundle without any dsh source changes
Desktop-only compatibility fixes for DeepSeek Harness queue continuation and cancellation presentation.

External dsh web GUI plugin: a git branch selector + Git graph in the conversation header's context hole (beside the official workspace selector), with real host-side git operations (switch/create) and guards, as a dsh profile bundle

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset — the first model request exposes only the builtin Minimal exact two-tool surface (persistent bash plus str_replace_editor) with no runtime contexts or injected instructions (Minimal-aligned trajectory anchor), promotion is gated on the first minimal-like reasoning block with a fallback, and the wire then switches to Code Mode (PTC, a single run_code tool over the full registry) with the ordinary injections returning afterwards. The preset files are synced into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets on host startup. Hot-pluggable — mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Live token estimates and generation throughput for DSH Web
A session-header agent mode switcher that applies in place for blank sessions and starts a safe same-workspace session after conversation history exists.
Page-aware whale particle theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI
鲸鱼娘宠物插件 for the dsh web GUI: a soft healing whale-girl companion that reacts to model activity (idle/waiting/thinking/tool/done), with petting/feeding interactions and an affinity score
Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry beside the settings button, one-time pairing tokens, live device status, and revocable mobile sessions

plugins.description: 皮肤全家桶聚合插件：装它 = 皮肤中心（skin-center）+ 全部皮肤资产（qq98 / ths / xp / blue-fantasy / dragon-heir / minecraft / miku / trading 等，内置在包的 skins/ 目录，无需每皮肤独立 npm 包）。皮肤启用互斥由 dsh-skin use 管理（~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml managed 区段），因此皮肤只进 skins/ 资产、不进 patchFrom。

manifests.description: DSH web GUI right-panel system: a pixel-faithful re-implementation of AionUi's Explorer + Preview columns (file tree, filename search, git changes, multi-tab preview of 10+ formats) driven by real host-side fs/git services, hot-pluggable via a profile bundle without any dsh source changes
Desktop-only compatibility fixes for DeepSeek Harness queue continuation and cancellation presentation.

External dsh web GUI plugin: a git branch selector + Git graph in the conversation header's context hole (beside the official workspace selector), with real host-side git operations (switch/create) and guards, as a dsh profile bundle

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset — the first model request exposes only the builtin Minimal exact two-tool surface (persistent bash plus str_replace_editor) with no runtime contexts or injected instructions (Minimal-aligned trajectory anchor), promotion is gated on the first minimal-like reasoning block with a fallback, and the wire then switches to Code Mode (PTC, a single run_code tool over the full registry) with the ordinary injections returning afterwards. The preset files are synced into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets on host startup. Hot-pluggable — mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Live token estimates and generation throughput for DSH Web
A session-header agent mode switcher that applies in place for blank sessions and starts a safe same-workspace session after conversation history exists.
Page-aware whale particle theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI
鲸鱼娘宠物插件 for the dsh web GUI: a soft healing whale-girl companion that reacts to model activity (idle/waiting/thinking/tool/done), with petting/feeding interactions and an affinity score
Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry beside the settings button, one-time pairing tokens, live device status, and revocable mobile sessions

manifests.description: DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the fifteen runtime plugins for the current profile.

AttackAtlas tab for the eight specialist security presets: per-mode architecture matrix (battle zones x tactics x items with per-mode terminal-state semantics), four-state coverage light-up, target anchoring, dispatch-on-double-click, attack-chain topology, custom work-methodology composer (layered run envelope, closure inquiry), tool/MCP/custom-tool modules with install-approval protocol, and a capability library of user-defined categories and items shared into the composer.

Campaign memory for the nine security presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.

DSH hunter plugin: FOFA / Hunter(qianxin) / Quake(360) aggregated asset search with unified DSL → per-platform syntax conversion, quota-aware pagination/export, API-key settings panel, and the code-audit live-verification pipeline (L0 fingerprint check on internet assets, L1 minimal-impact EXP only on user-authorized assets).
MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page.

DSH web client plugin: two-tier agent-preset picker on the new-session screen — built-ins and the researcher entry stay top-level while the eight professional security modes fold into a hover/click submenu, viewport-adaptive, with no other surface touched.

DSH subagent providers for the local claude-code / codex CLIs: registers the host-plane 'claude-code' and 'codex' providers the nine security presets' tool rows name. The CLIs keep their own model backend config (~/.claude/settings.json env, ~/.codex/config.toml); this plugin only spawns them headless and maps exit to a subagent run.

Session-scoped redteam findings registry for the nine security presets: model-side register/update/delete tools, a self-registered loopback web channel, and a per-session conversation tab (redteam 成果) with per-mode pages across all nine modes (board style per mode: findings / assets / ledger / timeline / cloudpath) plus a cross-session global ledger overview, severity stats, type distribution, lifecycle status, pagination, verify-to-session and MD/HTML exports.

DSH host-plane refusal-repair proximity injection for the five security presets: watches assistant turn text on session/event, detects refusal/moralizing patterns (two-tier: strong phrases full-text + weak keywords head-150, ), and when a hit lands re-injects a one-shot authorized-context reminder as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. RuntimeContextProjection dedupes: the reminder lands only when it appears (text change) and disappears after the repaired turn (change back to empty) — steady state costs nothing. Non-security presets resolve no preset id and render nothing.

DSH host-plane route booster for the nine security presets: infers the current (mode, phase) from the latest user message (sticky phase memory) and re-injects a compact governance envelope — gate checklist (from dsh-stage-gate GATES), review/double-sign reminder, boundary line, evidence-level pre-judgment, refs pointers or a forced-search nudge on miss — as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing.

DSH scanner-wrapper plugin (preset-plane, pentest/attack-defense): nuclei/httpx/ffuf as model tools with built-in rate discipline (conservative defaults, audited overrides), evidence-index landing, nuclei-hits→scan-reconcile pending rows, and assets.md registration enforcement for active scans (防盲打). Local binaries only — never auto-installs; MCP/install-request fallback hints built in.

DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the nine security presets : ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the nine security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md.

DSH semgrep wrapper plugin (preset-plane, code-audit): local semgrep as a model tool with the preset's offline rule sets (java 402 built-in + php + oss 1080 auto-located), evidence-index landing, dual-writes hits to scan-reconcile.md/.csv as pending rows (hit != vuln — reconcile via register sourceOrigin), metrics off, local binary only — never auto-installs.

Session status panel for the nine security presets: header progress chip (task-list projection with completion bar), subagent chip with a right-side subagent directory drawer (running/finished groups, click a name to open that subagent session), and a left-center prompt rail listing user prompts with hover preview and click-to-locate on the chat anchor.

DSH stage-gate host plugin: the stage_gate / gates_list model tools validate task-workspace artifacts against the nine security presets' gate schemas (structural checks, v1), append verdicts to gate-log.md, and list each mode's canonical gate files

dsh 整合包（聚合版）：27 个插件一键装 —— bundle 组合流 + 本地 file: 依赖（照 dsh-mega 模式）
DSH WebUI 登录系统（Marisa 发行）— /auth/* 登录路由 + /api 硬门 + tapIndex 软门
mygo managed-plugin CLI: pack/restore/init as a dsh app plugin (design-r5)
Managed-plugin lifecycle and mount-time validation bridge between the dsh-mygo-api contract and Cordis
mygo fabric extension governance shell: extension registry first entry + managed-block enable/disable of the fabric composition seam
MyGO managed-plugin panel for the dsh web settings page (settings.section slot + /api/mygo/* routes)
mygo hub LoaderAdapter: dsh-hub registry (omdsh-registry/v1) fetch/verify/fallback, install-intent translation, and collections — as a mygo governed plugin
DeepSeek Harness plugin: manage user skills (~/.dsh/skills) via slash commands and the skill_manage tool.
dsh 整合包（聚合版）：27 个插件一键装 —— bundle 组合流 + 本地 file: 依赖（照 dsh-mega 模式）

Agent2Agent interop for the DeepSeek Harness in one package — the realtime mesh hub (project registry, immutable message history, WebSocket presence) and mesh client (per-agent connections, serial injection), the model-facing a2a_peers / a2a_message / a2a_history tools, and the /a2a command surface
A2A collaboration controls for the web GUI: one shared Host snapshot drives the overview, project manager, composer badge, and quick connection panel
Resume an interrupted conversation from the composer: the send button becomes a play button that submits 继续/Continue.

DSH plugin (Marisa fork of MAXeaglet/dsh-bash-terminal 0.3.14): one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, MSYS2, Git Bash, or WSL on Windows. Default terminal chosen by the user in Web UI settings; the model may switch per call via the shell argument when the user asks.

DSH web plugin: a VSCode-like right sidebar (explorer / editor / terminal / git / browser), isolated per conversation session. Exposes a service for other plugins to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.
Persistent, reviewable, and safely restorable workspace change sets for DeepSeek Harness
DSH 代码地图插件：symbol 索引 / 文档符号 / 调用层级 / 继承树——给模型补上「地图型」语义查询（LSP 之上，零 SDK 依赖）

DSH diff-viewer plugin: PiUI-style visual diff surface (split/unified, change bars, line numbers, word-level marks, collapsed context, windowed rendering) replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls. Registers into the ui-tool diff-card chain slots.
Drag local files into the DSH Web UI and insert their original filesystem paths without uploading or copying them

ego-browser (ego-lite) integration plugin for DSH: structured browser-automation tools (30+ ego_*) that drive the vendored ego runtime through ctx.subprocess, plus a realtime watch panel (live SSE screencast + direct mouse interaction with the agent browser + download capture + human-verification notice + tab bar + login guide).

GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive UI components rendered inline in assistant replies via the ```dsh-ui fence — layout, charts, plots, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model. Ships the fence-teaching host plugin, the browser renderer (client half), and the genui skill.
DSH profile bundle：git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份（优先 gh CLI 登录账号，GitHub noreply 邮箱），GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* 环境变量注入压过一切 git config
Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
